assumption_boundaries: bytes 1.11.1 implementation is assumed verified; std/bytes.rs is an external model, not proof of the dependency source
UTF-8 error exactness uses the pre-existing trusted utf8_error_matches contract
Hasher callback preservation contracts are a conditional std protocol; default wrappers are specification-wrapper proofs against pinned core shapes, not source-included core proofs
Formatter::pad and DebugStruct/DebugTuple builder append contracts are audited std premises; exact formatting is not modeled
The bundled prelude models char values with < 0x10FFFF, excluding valid Rust char U+10FFFF; ByteStr UTF-8 model does not faithfully cover that scalar
runtime_note: ByteStr unsafe debug validation remains present but uses a static panic message; the panic text differs for invalid unsafe inputs.
